'''Relays''' were small [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] ships slightly larger than [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape Fighters]]. They were used c. [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'' carried a Relay in its docking bay.<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>
